description: This file contains utility functions for managing post permissions, including checks for post priority, hardened mode, user permissions, and burn-on-read restrictions within the Mattermost server.

methods.name: PostPriorityCheckWithApp
methods.description: Checks if a post with specific priority settings is allowed based on user permissions, license, and configuration.

methods.name: postPriorityCheck
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of post priority, including license restrictions and notification settings.

methods.name: PostHardenedModeCheckWithApp
methods.description: Checks if hardened mode restrictions are violated based on configuration and properties.

methods.name: postHardenedModeCheck
methods.description: Validates if reserved properties are used when hardened mode is enabled.

methods.name: userCreatePostPermissionCheckWithApp
methods.description: Verifies if a user has permission to create a post in a specific channel.

methods.name: PostBurnOnReadCheckWithApp
methods.description: Validates whether a burn-on-read post can be created based on channel type and participants.
